bio.text: Patrick Halpin is a Democratic candidate for New York's 2nd Congressional District on Long Island; he is a former Suffolk County Executive and announced his campaign in July 2025.

According to his campaign website, he was first elected at age 26 to the Suffolk County Legislature, then became the first Democrat in more than a century elected to the Assembly from the Town of Babylon, and later the youngest Suffolk County Executive ever elected.

His campaign website says he later chaired the Suffolk County Water Authority and currently chairs the Town of Babylon Planning Board; it also says he was student body president at West Babylon High School.

sources.title: Pat Halpin announces challenge to Garbarino in House race
